message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a built‑in function that can pull the official holiday calendar for Canada directly. However, based on the publicly available 2023 Canadian holiday schedule, the following dates typically create long weekends:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend Span |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Jan 1 2023 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Jan 1–3 (Sunday–Tuesday) |
| Feb 20 2023 | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK) | Monday | Feb 18–20 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Apr 7 2023 | Good Friday | Friday | Apr 7–9 (Friday–Sunday) |
| May 22 2023 | Victoria Day | Monday | May 20–22 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Jul 1 2023 | Canada Day | Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Sep 4 2023 | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 2–4 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Oct 9 2023 | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 7–9 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Nov 11 2023 | Remembrance Day | Wednesday | Nov 10–12 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Dec 25 2023 | Christmas Day | Monday | Dec 23–25 (Saturday–Monday) |

These are the most common long‑weekend opportunities in Canada for 2023. If you need an official, up‑to‑date list or want to confirm province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day isn’t observed in all provinces), you might want to consult the Government of Canada’s official holiday calendar or a dedicated holiday‑API service.
